finalReview.evidence: Independent exact-head R2 review at 34e44a599c7ce48848953ac3c6a4acd859acc791 confirmed a direct child of 6ffafc0390694345633633d688148c020226126c whose only governed change sequences the existing public verification owners into a structure-first phase followed by the unchanged Python and .NET phase whenever both structure and restore-capable .NET verification are selected.
